extracted.name: Asian Pineapple Sauce
extracted.description: Pineapple sauce for teriyaki chicken and Asian noodles.
ingredient_lines: 4 slices canned pineapple in juice, drained and chopped
instruction_lines: Combine the pineapple juice, teriyaki sauce, soy sauce, lemon juice, pineapple, sugar, and garlic powder in a saucepan over medium heat; cook until the liquid has reduced to a syrup, about 5 minutes. Stir the water through the mixture; continue cooking until the mixture thickens again. Remove from heat and serve immediately.
